name: TransUnion
sector: Financials — consumer credit reporting & data analytics (SIC 7320)
moat_justification: Regulated three-bureau oligopoly with an irreplicable consumer-file database and real switching costs, but TransUnion is the smallest of the three with no exclusive verification database comparable to Equifax's Work Number, and measured ROIC proxy ran only 1.1–7.2% over FY2020–25 on an acquisition-built, goodwill-heavy balance sheet — the FY2023 UK goodwill impairment is direct evidence of overpayment, so the history does not prove a wide moat.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 7.7x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (6.6%) vs bull-case tier C (10.5%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Oligopoly credit-bureau data franchise, moat 6/10, but levered and with low measured ROIC — on TTM OE of $2.80/share it does not clear 15% at $74.08 (weighted IRR 8.85%, IV@15 $35.13); it clears 15% only at or below $35.13.
moat_for: One of only three national credit bureaus — ~200M U.S. consumer files and ~10,000 furnisher relationships no entrant can replicate
Switching costs — lender underwriting, models and compliance workflows built around bureau data
Diversifying recurring non-mortgage revenue (fraud, identity, marketing, emerging verticals) on the OneTru platform
Mid-60s gross margin in the last tagged years (FY2016–19: 64.5–66.6%)
moat_against: Measured ROIC proxy only 1.1–7.2% (FY2020–25); goodwill-heavy balance sheet from acquisitions
FY2023 UK goodwill impairment of $414M — direct evidence an acquisition overpaid
Smallest of the Big Three vs Equifax, Experian, LexisNexis and FICO; FICO royalty pricing is an upstream margin headwind
Mortgage / consumer-lending cyclicality — OE/share fell to −$0.43 in FY2022
Leverage (net debt $4.25B, 7.73x normalized OE) plus permanent regulatory / data-privacy exposure
